MOD_HOST_REPLY_CODES.doc: Two of mod-host's own refusals, as the hosts that speak its protocol answer them (mod-host.h).

invalidOperation.doc: ERR_INVALID_OPERATION: a word outside the verb's grammar

paramSymbolInvalid.doc: ERR_LV2_INVALID_PARAM_SYMBOL: a symbol that is not a parameter of the instance

PLUGIN_HOSTD_REPLY_CODES.doc: The refusals plugin-hostd adds to mod-host's that its param_info and chain answer (protocol.h PHD_ERRORS, plugin-hostd 0.11.0).

noParamContract.doc: PHD_ERR_NO_PARAM_CONTRACT: the host holds no checked unit and scale for this parameter

chainUnknownInstance.doc: PHD_ERR_CHAIN_UNKNOWN_INSTANCE: a member is an instance no add made

chainDuplicate.doc: PHD_ERR_CHAIN_DUPLICATE: an instance is named twice in one chain

chainInstanceBusy.doc: PHD_ERR_CHAIN_INSTANCE_BUSY: a member is already in another chain

chainMixedFormat.doc: PHD_ERR_CHAIN_MIXED_FORMAT: no one worker program runs every member
